note: Read 2026-10-31. The official legislation site (mevzuat.gov.tr) and the Official Gazette (resmigazete.gov.tr) gave no answer all day, and archive.org's snapshots of mevzuat.gov.tr's PDFs (4857, 7179, 4721) couldn't be fetched (connections reset, six tries each). Service: Askeralma Kanunu (Law No. 7179, adopted 25 June 2019), in the excerpt the Ministry of Family and Social Services publishes (aile.gov.tr): art. 2: the Law applies to every male citizen; art. 3(a): military age runs from 1 January of the year a man turns twenty to 1 January of the year he turns forty-one. Art. 5(2), in the full text the legal news site Hukuki Haber publishes (marked secondary): service lasts six months for privates and corporals, twelve for reserve officers and NCOs (not held); the President may double or halve it,; paid exemption (bedelli askerlik, art. 10) isn't held. Women aren't called. Majority: null; Türk Medeni Kanunu (Law No. 4721) art. 11 sets majority at eighteen, but the Ministry's excerpt holds other articles and the full text wasn't reached. Work: null; İş Kanunu (Law No. 4857) art. 71 and the regulation on children's and young workers' employment weren't reached (the Ministry's excerpt holds other articles). The blocker file records the attempts.

sources.title: Asker Alma Kanunu (No. 7179), excerpt published by the Ministry of Family and Social Services (aile.gov.tr)
sources.said: Kabul Tarihi: 25/6/2019 Sayısı: 7179 ... (1) Bu Kanun, Türkiye Cumhuriyeti vatandaşı olan her erkek için uygulanır. ... a) Askerlik çağı: Nüfus kayıtlarına göre her erkeğin 20 yaşına girdiği yılın ocak ayının birinci gününden başlayan ve 41 yaşına girdiği yılın ocak ayının birinci gününde biten süreyi,

sources.title: Askeralma Kanunu tam metin (Hukuki Haber)
sources.said: (2) Hizmet süresi; erbaş ve erler için altı ay, yedek subay ve yedek astsubaylar için on iki aydır.
